name: Normal response
description: The provider commits and acknowledges one ticket.

name: Lost acknowledgement
description: The write commits but its response is lost.

name: Timeout before commit
description: The request fails before the provider writes.

name: Late commit
description: The original write is still running when a retry arrives.

name: Stale read with keys
description: Read-back lags behind a committed write; keys remain available.

name: No lookup with keys
description: The provider supports keys but no read-back.

name: No provider keys
description: The lost acknowledgement can be reconciled with read-back.

name: Late commit without keys
description: An empty lookup does not prove the original request failed.

name: Stale lookup without keys
description: A committed write is invisible for several clock ticks.

name: No recovery contract
description: Neither idempotency nor lookup is available after a lost response.

name: Work can remain unfinished
description: The first request never writes; the caller cannot establish that fact.

name: Malformed response
description: The ticket exists, but the response cannot be parsed.

name: Transport redelivery with keys
description: One tool call is delivered twice; the provider honors keys.

name: Transport redelivery without keys
description: Duplicate effects occur inside the provider boundary without caller retries.

name: Rate limit
description: A definite non-write response includes a retry delay.

name: Prolonged outage
description: All writes time out before reaching the service.

name: Explicit rejection
description: The provider explicitly rejects every write.

name: Read-back unavailable
description: The write commits, its acknowledgement is lost, and lookup is down.

name: Expired deduplication window
description: The provider forgets a key before a retry; no lookup is available.

name: Worker restart after write
description: The worker stops after dispatch and before recording the response.

name: Restart without keys
description: A durable intent survives but the acknowledgement is not saved.

name: Restart during uncertainty
description: The request does not write and the worker stops before recording the timeout.

name: Authorization expired
description: The provider refuses writes after authorization expiration.

name: Authorization expires in flight
description: The provider checks authorization again when a delayed write commits.
